tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Call this when your AI agent is stuck on work software cannot do: phone calls, real-world photos, local pickup/checks, human judgment, verification, QA, or physical presence. Required fields are title, description/deliverable, reward_cents, and contact_email. The first task for a new contact_email i

tools.name: post_human_task
tools.description: Alias for post_task. Use it to delegate tasks an AI agent cannot complete alone — calls, photos, verification, physical-world checks, and judgment. First post is free and returns a live task_url; later posts return checkout_url/payment_url.

tools.name: hire_human
tools.description: Alias for post_task. Use when the agent should stop guessing and hire a human. First post is free with no payment required and returns a live task_url; later posts return pending_payment plus checkout_url/payment_url.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_task · Public sink: post_task, post_human_task, hire_human.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_task · Public sink: post_task, post_human_task, hire_human

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
